description: This file contains unit tests for the SettingsNetworkingHelpers utility functions, which parse host and port strings and generate HTTP URLs, primarily testing IPv4, IPv6, hostname formats, and edge cases.

classes.name: SettingsNetworkingHelpersTests
classes.description: A test suite for the SettingsNetworkingHelpers utility functions, verifying correct parsing and URL string generation.

methods.name: parseHostPortParsesIPv4
methods.description: Tests that parseHostPort correctly parses an IPv4 address with port.

methods.name: parseHostPortParsesHostnameAndTrims
methods.description: Tests parsing of hostname with surrounding whitespace.

methods.name: parseHostPortParsesBracketedIPv6
methods.description: Tests parsing of bracketed IPv6 address with port.

methods.name: parseHostPortRejectsMissingPort
methods.description: Ensures parseHostPort returns nil for address strings missing port.

methods.name: parseHostPortRejectsInvalidPort
methods.description: Ensures parseHostPort returns nil when port is invalid.

methods.name: httpURLStringFormatsIPv4AndPort
methods.description: Verifies that httpURLString correctly formats IPv4 address with port.

methods.name: httpURLStringBracketsIPv6
methods.description: Verifies that httpURLString formats IPv6 address with brackets and port.

methods.name: httpURLStringLeavesAlreadyBracketedIPv6
methods.description: Ensures the function preserves already-bracketed IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: httpURLStringFallsBackWhenMissingHostOrPort
methods.description: Tests fallback behavior when host or port is missing.
